label: few-shot calibration — MID anchor
artifact: illustrative, not an FSK product — a competently styled but generic SaaS dashboard
description: A real design system was applied (consistent spacing, a real type scale, a coherent palette) but it is the SAME token set copy-pasted from a popular design language with zero product-specific identity: any B2B tool could wear this exact skin unchanged.

design_quality.evidence: Consistent 8px spacing grid, clear type hierarchy (headline/body/caption distinguishable at a glance), cards have real elevation, forms are grouped in labeled fieldsets.

originality.evidence: This is a well-known design language's default palette and component shapes applied verbatim, with no accent color, iconography, or layout choice tied to the product's own domain. Feels like a template preview, not a specific product.

craft.evidence: Null values render as an em dash, dates are humanized, empty states have real copy and a call-to-action button.

functionality.evidence: Every field is reachable in create and edit, search/pagination work as expected, navigation is discoverable from any screen.

verdict_note: Passes design_quality/craft/functionality but fails originality — competent execution of someone else's design decisions is not the same as a decision made FOR this product. This is the exact failure mode `identical-reskin-across-products` names.
